title: macaranga cordifolia
intro: Macaranga cordifolia, commonly known as "Bua" or "Bai", is a medicinal plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of M. cordifolia include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of M. cordifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
